mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_template (code, name, channel, subject, body_html, variables, language, is_active, email_template_id, created_by, updated_by) VALUES ( #{code}, #{name}, #{channel}, #{subject}, #{bodyHtml}, COALESCE(#{variables}, '[]')::jsonb, #{language}, #{isActive}, #{emailTemplateId}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification_template
AND is_active = #{isActive}
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_template SET name = #{name}, channel = #{channel}, subject = #{subject}, body_html = #{bodyHtml}, variables = COALESCE(#{variables}, '[]')::jsonb, language = #{language}, is_active = #{isActive}, email_template_id = #{emailTemplateId}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
